parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A rule tree as JSON that the books must match. A rule has a field, an op and values: author, narrator, series and tag take op in with names; person takes in with names, an author under every spelling of their name; language takes in with codes such as en; format takes in with formats such as epub; files takes in with missing or none-on-disk; ereader takes in with large-document, large-fonts, large-image, missing-resources, malformed-document or broken-toc, what makes a file slow or troublesome on an e-reader; genre takes in with keys of the genre list such as crime, a genre of the book's tags or one a person accepted; published takes between with a first and a last year, either empty for no limit; words takes like with words of at least three letters, a book whose title, an author or the series looks like them as GET /books/search finds them. Every field but person, format, files, ereader, words and status also takes op empty without values. Status takes in with unread, reading, completed, abandoned or wishlist; rating takes in with stars from 1 to 5, or between with a lowest and a highest. Both are the caller's own. Rules combine under all, any and not.

parameters.name: sort
